extracted.intended_audience: People attempting to create or locate a Wikipedia article (new or casual contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements shown when an English Wikipedia article title does not exist; explains account requirements, troubleshooting, and steps to find or request/create the page. Useful for users trying to create or locate a specific article (here: 'Obama jokes').

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users may create articles; if you lack an account or autoconfirmed status, use other submission routes (article wizard or draft).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create a live article directly (e.g., new user, subject-notable concerns), submit a draft via the article wizard or file a request so experienced editors can review and create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Obama jokes' in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check whether the topic already exists under another title or is covered within other articles; use Wikipedia search to avoid creating duplicates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links to find mentions, redirects, or related coverage that indicate where content about the topic already lives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and alternative capitalizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try variations in capitalization and consider creating redirects so readers can find the article under alternative spellings or capitalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay and purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a recently created page but can't see it, either wait briefly for database propagation or use the purge action to refresh the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page previously existed but was removed, consult the deletion log and the linked help page to understand deletion reasons and whether recreation is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider adding a redirect to the correct title
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the desired title is a variant of an existing page, create a redirect from the variant to the canonical article to improve discoverability.
